title: KTM and Husqvarna Motorcycles Recall Closed Course Competition Motorcycles Due to Crash Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: Water can get into the battery causing a short circuit, posing a crash hazard. Units: About 300.

title: Melaleuca Recalls Three-Wick Revive Candles Due to Fire and Burn Hazards (Recall Alert)
summary: The candles' high flames can ignite the surface of the wax, posing fire and burn hazards. Units: About 38,000.

title: Hillsdale Furniture Recalls Jennings Counter and Bar Stools Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The stool seat can break off the base, posing a fall hazard. Units: About 10,570.

title: Lifetime Products Recalls 6-Foot Seminar Tables Due to Injury Risk
summary: The brace arms can fail to lock the table legs into place and the table can collapse, posing an injury risk to consumers. Units: About 43,000.

title: Casa Kids Recalls for Repair Cabina Bunk Beds Due to Fall Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The screws that hold the bed's mattress foundation to the bed's guardrails can be loose and the mattress foundation can fall, posing a fall risk to children in the bunk bed. Units: About 195.

title: Polaris Recalls Ranger Recreational Off-Highway Vehicles and ProXD Utility Vehicles Due to Crash Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The throttle pedal can return to the idle position more slowly than anticipated once the pedal is released or stick in the depressed position, posing a crash hazard. Units: About 15,800 (In addition, 711 units were sold in Canada).

title: Haro Bicycles Recalls Masi Evoluzione and Gran Corsa Bicycles Due to Fall Hazard and Risk of Injury
summary: The bicycle's fork steerer tube can break, causing the rider to lose control, fall and suffer injuries. Units: About 510.

title: Inyo Pool Products Recalls PureLine Pool Pump Motors Due to Fire Hazard; Sold Exclusively on inyopools.com (Recall Alert)
summary: The pool pump motors can overheat, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 800.

title: KTM, Husqvarna and GASGAS Recall Closed Course Competition Motorcycles Due to Crash Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The drive chain can break, posing a crash hazard and/or property damage. Units: About 1,470.

title: Polaris Recalls Ranger Recreational Off-Highway Vehicles and ProXD, Gravely and Bobcat Utility Vehicles Due to Fire Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The drive belt can break during operation and damage the inner clutch cover assembly and fuel line, which can result in a fuel leak, posing a fire hazard. title: Birdie Belay Devices Recalled Due to Risk of Injury; Made by Beal Sas
summary: The device user can be unable to lower the climber, posing a risk of injury to the climber. Units: About 1,400.

title: Flame King Recalls Hog 100-Pound Propane Cylinders Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The propane cylinders manufactured with a handle below the weld on the side could leak propane gas, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 500.

title: Briggs & Stratton Recalls YTL Log Splitters with Briggs & Stratton Engines Due to Injury Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: An incorrect engine ignition coil and flywheel can lead to hard starting and engine kick back, posing an injury hazard to the operator. Units: About 9,750 (In addition, 290 were sold in Canada).

title: Genentech Recalls Prescription Drug Evrysdi Due to Failure to Meet Child Resistant Packaging Requirements; Risk of Drug Exposure through Eye or Skin Absorption (Recall Alert)
summary: The bottles containing the prescription drug can leak due to a fit issue between the press-in bottle adapter and bottleneck. title: HD Hudson Recalls Battery-Powered Sprayers Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The sprayer's lithium-ion battery can overheat, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 64,000.

title: Parker Squared Recalls Shepherd Boy Plush Toys with Wire Shepherd's Staff Due to Laceration Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The metal wire in the shepherd's staff can become exposed, posing a laceration hazard. Units: About 3,000 (In addition, about 10 were sold in Canada).

title: Global Home Imports Recalls Platform Bed Frames Due to Serious Injury Hazard
summary: The HR platform frame can collapse, posing a crush hazard that can result in severe injury or death. Units: About 82,000.

title: HOFISH Recalls Mattresses Due to Violation of Federal Flammability Standard; Sold Exclusively on Amazon.com
summary: The mattresses fail to meet the mandatory federal flammability standard for mattresses, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 700.
